Subject: OpsBridge co-sell: APAC slot stretch + cutover plan

Hi Amit / CloudWave team —

Thanks again for lining up the co-sell demo next week. Quick note on logistics: we have a 60-minute slot at 02:30 UTC which maps awkwardly across your APAC SE attendees and our GCP SI. With multiple SI hosts joining, I'd like to propose a small "stretch-and-cutover" plan so we can guarantee the customer sees the end-to-end flow even if we need to trim the advanced ops deep-dive.

Proposed approach (high-level):
- First 30 min: shared run-through (architecture, key value props for Marketplace + co-sell motion)
- Next 20 min: parallel breakout (Tech host demo + Partner business Q&A) — the tech host runs a trimmed sequence if we need to save time
- Final 10 min: cutover and next steps + action items

If this works, I'll drop the runbook and an updated agenda (attached) and route the calendar invite with explicit host handoff notes. Please confirm the APAC-friendly start time below or share constraints:
- Option A: 02:30 UTC / 11:30 SGT (preferred for APAC stakeholders)
- Option B: 03:00 UTC / 12:00 SGT (if we need extra buffer for partner setup)

Also flagging Marketplace contacts on this thread to ensure any procurement/process notes are captured.

Attachments: OpsBridge_runbook_v3.pdf (runbook), OpsBridge_demo_agenda.xlsx (timeline)

Thanks —
Olga

Thanks Olga — that structure makes sense. Our APAC team prefers Option A (11:30 SGT) but we have one SI lead who is in India and can do 12:00 as well. Short question: can the breakout run for 25 minutes instead of 20 if we compress the final Q&A to 5 minutes? That gives the engineering lead enough time to run the end-to-end failover demo.

Also please send the runbook and agenda — I want to circulate an internal prep note to our field engineers.

Amit —

Yes to Option A and +1 to giving the tech host 25 minutes. Updated timing in the attached agenda (I moved the final Q&A to 5 min and added explicit handoff markers). The runbook includes a fallback: if the SI lead needs more time we cut the advanced observability toggle demo and demo a pre-recorded clip instead (runs ~4m). That keeps the customer-facing flow intact.

Forwarding runbook highlights here for quick scan:
- Host roles: Redwood (intro + cutover), CloudWave (business benefits + marketplace flow), SI (technical deep-dive)
- Cutover triggers: network latency > 250ms OR model cold-starts > 20s -> initiate parallel breakout and use cached responses
- Escalation: Marketplace procurement contact (aws-marketplace@amazon.com) to validate billing questions immediately after demo

Attachments included: OpsBridge_runbook_v3.pdf, OpsBridge_demo_agenda.xlsx, cutover-checklist.txt

Vanessa Ortiz
Partner Ops, Redwood Inference
